title: Mission (Im)Possible: Towards Autonomous Discovery of Autopilot Logic Flaws in Open-Source Drone Frameworks
title_zh: 任务（不）可能：面向开源无人机框架中自动驾驶逻辑缺陷的自主发现

paragraphs.en: 本文介绍了一种名为“不可能任务发现器”的新系统，用于发现自动驾驶无人机中的逻辑缺陷。 Autonomous drones are increasingly deployed in safety-critical tasks, yet their autopilot software can still contain subtle logic flaws that lead to unsafe behaviors. These flaws are difficult to discover with existing techniques because they often depend on semantic relationships across modules, commands, and runtime state, and rarely manifest as crashes or detectable failures. With recent advances in LLMs, we observe that, when equipped with essential domain knowledge and carefully crafted context, LLMs demonstrate strong capabilities in understanding the high-level semantics of autopilot systems, making them suitable for logic flaw discovery. However, LLMs are limited by their context and can be biased to the vulnerabilities frequently occurs in training dataset, while logic flaws often require higher-level semantic bug oracles to identify their existence. To bridge the gap, we present Impossible Mission Finder (IMF), a multi-agent system combining static analysis, dynamic execution and log analysis, that supports fully automated identify, test, and validate logic flaws in autonomous vehicles. IMF primarily contains three LLM agents, it first uses the auditor agent to propose logic flaw hypothesis based on carefully-crafted program slicing, then it launches tester agents to write and execute test cases for each candidate, and finally it spawns the log analyzer agent to validate the execution log against the flaw hypothesis. This enables IMF dynamically validate bug oracles in a case-by-case manner, making it suitable for discovering logic flaws that do not have a unified pattern. We evaluated IMF on two widely used open-source autopilot systems, PX4 and Ardupilot, leading to 105 previously unknown logic flaws, that can cause unsafe behaviors including mission interruption failures, invalid actions, entering into restricted fly zones etc.
paragraphs.zh: 本文介绍了一种名为“不可能任务发现器”的新系统，用于发现自动驾驶无人机中的逻辑缺陷。自动驾驶无人机正越来越多地部署在安全性至关重要的任务中，但其自动驾驶软件仍可能包含细微的逻辑缺陷，从而导致不安全的行为。 现有技术难以发现这些缺陷，因为它们通常依赖于模块、指令和运行时状态之间的语义关系，且很少表现为崩溃或可检测的故障。 随着大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展，我们发现，当配备必要的领域知识和精心设计的上下文时，LLM 在理解自动驾驶系统的高层语义方面展现出强大能力，因此适合用于逻辑缺陷的发现。 然而，LLM 受其上下文限制，并且可能对训练数据集中频繁出现的漏洞产生偏见，而逻辑缺陷通常需要更高层的语义错误预言机来识别其存在。 为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了“不可能任务发现器”（Impossible Mission Finder, IMF），这是一个结合了静态分析、动态执行和日志分析的多人智能体系统，支持对自动驾驶车辆中的逻辑缺陷进行全自动的识别、测试和验证。 IMF 主要包含三个 LLM 智能体：首先使用审计员智能体基于精心设计的程序切片提出逻辑缺陷假设；然后启动测试员智能体为每个候选缺陷编写并执行测试用例；最后生成日志分析员智能体，以验证执行日志是否符合该缺陷假设。 这使得 IMF 能够针对具体案例动态验证错误预言机，从而适合发现那些没有统一模式的逻辑缺陷。 我们在两个广泛使用的开源自动驾驶系统 PX4 和 Ardupilot 上对 IMF 进行了评估，共发现了 105 个此前未知的逻辑缺陷，这些缺陷可能导致任务中断失败、无效操作、进入受限飞行区域等不安全行为。
